subject: JacksonHealth - access control evidence and SCIM snapshot request
messages:
From: Allison Roy <a.roy@jacksonhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Jackson Health Security <security@jacksonhealth.com>; Procurement Team <procurement@jacksonhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Access control evidence needed for SIG/SOC2 intake

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the quick onboarding demo yesterday. Our security team is starting the SIG/SOC2 intake and has a few targeted asks around access control for Redwood’s hosted service. Can you please provide the following artifacts and a short narrative for each?

- Sample SAML assertions for IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows (with PII redacted)
- A recent SCIM delta export showing user provisioning/deprovisioning events for a 48-hour window
- Current RBAC/role matrix (roles, privileges, provisioning owner)
- The runbook we use for onboarding service accounts and shared credentials

If possible we’d like the files by EOD Monday (15 Feb). Also let me know if you need an NDA or secure upload link.

Appreciate it—
Allison
Allison Roy
Security Program Manager
Jackson Health Systems
Allison.Roy@jacksonhealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Allison Roy <a.roy@jacksonhealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 10:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Access control evidence needed for SIG/SOC2 intake

Allison —

Thanks for the clear list. We can deliver the files you requested. Quick notes before we pull the artifacts:

- SAML assertions: we will redact all PII and will provide both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated examples.
- SCIM delta: the platform keeps SCIM change logs for 90 days; a 48-hour export is straightforward but we need the target time window. If you give us a TZ and window (e.g., 2026-01-29 00:00 to 2026-01-30 23:59 UTC) we’ll export it.
- RBAC matrix: we’ll include a mapping to owner contacts and the last review date.
- Provisioning runbook: we’ll include the current runbook PDF and a short changelog.

We’ll stage everything in a password-protected ZIP on Dropbox and share a link. I’ll tag Jordan (platform ops) and Marissa (CS) to assist with redaction and timeline.

Proposed delivery: Monday 15 Feb by 5pm PT. If Procurement needs a different upload method (SFTP, Box with eDiscovery), let me know.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Allison Roy <a.roy@jacksonhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Jackson Health Security <security@jacksonhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 08:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Access control evidence needed for SIG/SOC2 intake

Ben —

Thanks. For the SCIM window please use: 2026-02-01T00:00:00Z through 2026-02-02T23:59:59Z. We prefer Dropbox; please mark the ZIP with an expiration and share the password via a separate channel (email is fine if it’s different from the Dropbox note).

One additional ask from Security: can you include a short narrative (~250 words) describing how you enforce least privilege for service accounts and how role changes are approved? That helps accelerate the SIG questionnaire.

Procurement doesn’t need an NDA for this stage.

-Allison

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Allison Roy <a.roy@jacksonhealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 16:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Access control evidence needed for SIG/SOC2 intake

Allison / Jackson Health team —

Delivery: attached is a ZIP with the requested artifacts and a short narrative on least-privilege controls. Files included: rbac_matrix_v1.xlsx, saml_assertion_samples.txt (PII redacted), scim_delta_sample.csv (48-hour window requested), provisioning_runbook_2026-02.pdf. For traceability we also included a short MD file with export timestamps and the account owner list.

Secure link: https://dropbox.com/scl/fi/abc123/jackson-health-evidence.zip?dl=0
Password (sent separately): [sent via SMS to Allison]

Notes / summary:
- SCIM deltas: exported from the provisioning service; rows include delta_type (create/update/delete), timestamp (UTC), actor_id (redacted), and target_user_id (hashed).
- RBAC matrix: shows internal roles (viewer, editor, admin), the Redwood product privileges mapped to each role, and the owner/contact for provisioning. Role change requests are submitted via our internal ticketing system (SUP-3421) and require manager + security approval for elevation to admin.
- Service accounts: creation requires a ticket and justification, keys are rotated every 90 days, key material stored in customer-scoped KMS, and usage scoped via per-service IAM policies. Temporary elevated access (break-glass) is time-limited and audited with automated alerting.

Action items: Jordan will follow up with a brief walk-through if you want a quick call to review the samples. Marissa will post the ZIP link in the HubSpot deal (HS-98765) and attach SUP-3421.

Thanks — please confirm receipt.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments referenced: rbac_matrix_v1.xlsx, saml_assertion_samples.txt, scim_delta_sample.csv, provisioning_runbook_2026-02.pdf
